name: Round Linking
description: Create a closed circle of links between pieces of content.
project_description:
The module provides a Views handler that allows to create a View block to better link your content. The main idea of the module is to link a site's content in a circular manner: each content item from a circle recieves N inbound links and reffers to N another content items.

 Internal linking is crucial for search engines because it helps establish the site's structure and hierarchy. Well-planned internal links guide search engine crawlers through the website, making it easier to discover and index all relevant pages.
